name: Desires
overview: Scripture reveals that God honors the desires of the righteous heart when those desires align with a reverent fear and delight in the Lord. The Psalms affirm that God satisfies the desires of every living thing and sustains those who cast their burdens upon Him, promising to grant the counsel and heartfelt wishes of His people. Proverbs emphasizes that while the wicked’s fears will come upon them, the desires of the righteous are granted, highlighting the intimate connection between a godly heart and answered prayers.
